column2: [intro]
In this complex world, with so much at stake,
I don’t care, I’d rather entertain for fun's sake.
No need to pick sides in every story told,
I just want to see folks laughing and bold.
I mock it all, I’m not too serious,
Controversy’s dull, it’s just too tedious.
I prefer the laughs, the jokes, and the play,
Living light-hearted, not taking life too seriously each day.
Debates and verbal fights are not for me,
I’d rather embrace jokes and let them be.
In this sea of tension, I sail with ease,
I disregard scandals and friendships I please.
I mock it all, a bit whimsical too,
Controversies just drift right over my view.
Nothing stops me, I spread cheer in song,
My goal is to make people smile all along.
[ solo ]
So friends, don’t take life too seriously,
Life’s too short for debates so endlessly.
Let’s choose laughter and moments so light,
For that’s what makes friendship truly bright.
[outro]
